description: Prioritize existing security, crash, accessibility, performance, store and dependency findings into a review plan with prerequisites, expected effects and validation. No project code runs, no automatic changes or unmeasured performance claims. Reports unassessed areas explicitly.

offline.description: true: make no network requests (skip the npm and React Native Directory lookups behind version, maintenance and vulnerability checks). Default false.

path.description: Folder of the React Native or Expo app (the one with package.json), absolute or relative to the workspace. Must be inside the folders this server may read.

name: improve_app
